application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Erection of a two-storey one bedroom detached house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the two-storey one bedroom house hereby approved shall match those used in the existing building at 23 Manor Avenue.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Proposed Block Plan & Design and Access Statement, received 09/11/2020; 23/2020/EX01A, received on 02/02/2021; 23/2020/02C, received on 18/02/2021; SAP Calculations, SAP Calculations (ASHP & PV) & Energy Statement, received on 25/02/2021; 23/2020/01C, received on 03/03/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Prior to first occupation of the two-storey one bedroom house hereby approved details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials for the existing and proposed houses shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials (including appearance and layout) shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - Prior to first occupation of the two-storey one bedroom house hereby approved a detailed plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected along the front, side and rear of the existing and proposed houses shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The boundary treatment shall be completed before the two-storey three bedroom house is occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - The front, side and rear garden shall be divided as shown on the plan drawing numbered 23/2020/01C and thereafter maintained as such for the duration of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the two-storey one bedroom house hereby approved details of cycle parking provision shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the new access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the width outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until the applicant has entered into a binding arrangement with the Council that will secure the Council's Carbon Offset Fund, in accordance with the zero carbon strategy set out in the Energy Statement hereby approved. Furthermore, the measures set out in the Energy Statement shall be put into effect, with evidence supplied (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) to the local planning authority to demonstrate that this has been done, before the dwelling is first occupied.

Condition : 10 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
	
At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.

At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.

No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 11 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.

Condition : 12 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the of the hereby approved two-storey one-bedroom house as shown on drawing Nos. 23/2020/01C & 23/2020/02C or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of its site shall be carried out.
